domain-information: A Library Member requests a membership to receive a library card.
A Library Member makes a loan of a book which is registered on the library card.
A Library Member reports a lost book to notify the staff of an issue.
A Member Services Clerk approves a new membership request and unlocks a library card to the new member.
A Member Services Clerk creates a new member record after receiving an application.
A Member Services Clerk logs a lost-book report to start a follow-up process.
A Librarian catalogs a newly acquired book to add it to the library system.
A Librarian updates a book’s status when it is returned or marked as lost.
A Collection Archivist inspects old or damaged books to decide whether they need restoration.
A Collection Archivist schedules a preservation task to protect fragile works.
A Collection Archivist approves or rejects donated materials after evaluating their condition.
A Collection Archivist forwards new supply of books to a librarian.
An Acquisitions Manager reviews purchase suggestions by a supplier to determine which new titles should be bought.
An Acquisitions Manager places an order for new books with an external supplier.
An Acquisitions Manager updates the acquisitions budget to reflect new expenses.
An Acquisitions Manager forwards new supply of books to a librarian.

domain objects.name: Library Member
domain objects.description: A person registered to use library services.

domain objects.name: Member Record
domain objects.description: The stored personal and borrowing information of a Library Member.

domain objects.name: Library Card
domain objects.description: The identification card issued to a Library Member.

domain objects.name: Loan
domain objects.description: A record of a Library Member borrowing a Book.

domain objects.name: Book
domain objects.description: A library item that can be borrowed.

domain objects.name: Status
domain objects.description: The current condition or availability state of a Book.

domain objects.name: Membership Request
domain objects.description: A request from a Library Member to obtain membership.

domain objects.name: Lost Book Report
domain objects.description: A report filed by a Library Member about a missing Book.

domain objects.name: Member Services Clerk
domain objects.description: A staff member responsible for assisting Library Members with administrative tasks.

domain objects.name: Librarian
domain objects.description: A staff member responsible for cataloging and managing library materials.

domain objects.name: Library System
domain objects.description: The catalog and inventory system used by the Librarian.

domain objects.name: Collection Archivist
domain objects.description: A staff member responsible for preserving and evaluating library materials.

domain objects.name: Inspection
domain objects.description: An assessment of a Book performed by the Collection Archivist.

domain objects.name: Preservation Task
domain objects.description: A restoration or protection activity scheduled for a Book.

domain objects.name: Book Donor
domain objects.description: A person or organization donating books to the library.

domain objects.name: Donation
domain objects.description: A contribution from a Book Donor.

domain objects.name: Book Supply
domain objects.description: A batch of provided books.

domain objects.name: Acquisitions Manager
domain objects.description: A staff member responsible for ordering new books and managing the acquisitions budget.

domain objects.name: External Supplier
domain objects.description: A provider that delivers Books to the library.

domain objects.name: Purchase Suggestion
domain objects.description: A proposed Book for acquisition.

domain objects.name: Order
domain objects.description: A request issued to acquire new Books.

domain objects.name: Acquisitions Budget
domain objects.description: The funds available for purchasing new Books.

associations.description: Library Member submits a Membership Request.
Member Services Clerk processes a Membership Request.
Member Services Clerk updates a Member Record.
Library Member files a Lost Book Report.
Member Services Clerk handles a Lost Book Report.
Member Services Clerk issues a Library Card.
Collection Archivist creates a Preservation Task.
Book Supply is delivered to the Librarian.
Acquisitions Manager evaluates a Purchase Suggestion.
